_comment: Regression fixture for adapter/hasher.ts determinism. If canonicalize.ts or hasher.ts is ever refactored (e.g. swapping the canonical-JSON library), these expected digests MUST still match — a mismatch means existing on-chain anchored proofs would no longer be reproducible from their off-chain records, which breaks every already-issued proof. Do NOT regenerate these values casually; regenerating them is only correct if you are deliberately bumping the schema/contract version for all NEW anchors going forward, in which case old records under the old version must remain separately verifiable under that old version.
_note_on_expected_hash_placeholders: The expectedHash values above are the actual deterministic digests generated by the current adapter/hasher.ts implementation for the corresponding fixture inputs. These values now serve as regression guards and should not be changed casually.
